verbatim_excerpt:
36-232 In districts with very low parking requirements

In C1-4, C1-5, C1-6, C1-7, C1-8, C1-9, C2-4, C2-5, C2-6, C2-7, C2-8, C4-4, C4-5, C4-6, C4-7, C5, C6, C7 within the #Greater Transit Zone#, C8-3 or C8-4 Districts, except for the #uses# listed in Section 36-233 (Exceptions to application of waiver provisions), the parking requirements set forth in Section 36-21 (General Provisions) or Section 36-22 (Special Provisions for a Single Zoning Lot With Uses Subject to Different Parking Requirements) shall not apply to:

(a) #commercial# #uses# in parking requirement category A1 or A2, if the total number of #accessory# off-street parking spaces required for all such #uses# on the #zoning lot# is less than 40, or 100 in the case of C6-1A Districts; or

(b) #commercial# #uses# in any one of parking requirement categories A3, A4, B1, C or F, or a permitted #community facility# #use#, if the number of #accessory# off-street parking spaces required for the #uses# in each such category or for each such #community facility# #use# is less than 40.
verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks joined by a blank line, in page order: [0] the displayed section number and title; then each body paragraph/list item. Defined terms (bold-italic in the HTML) are written #term#. Ordered-list item labels are the labels the section's own print/PDF prints (nesting depth: (a)/(b)..., then (1)/(2)..., then (i)/(ii)...); the HTML renders them as CSS markers. A superscript footnote marker is written ^N. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures omitted. No word changed.
notes: Captured as source text only for task M4-T036 (D-090 R291, R517, R526; backlog DB-188): the Zoning Resolution texts the two independent step-P5 readings named as not had. The capture holds the official source text and its provenance; it encodes no rule, no reading of the text for any lot, and no number derived from it.

Channel: the authoritative, sha256-and-byte-pinned channel is the canonical section HTML (raw_html_sha256 and response_bytes in source). The section's own print/PDF render was fetched once and used ONLY as a text check; per M4-T025 finding F4 (DB-167) the PDF bytes are regenerated per request and are NOT pinned.
Further sections this text points to that are NOT captured by this snapshot: 36-233, 36-21, 36-22.

The pinned raw_html_sha256 and response_bytes are of THIS session's fetch of the whole page. The page's non-body chrome carries a per-render Drupal form token (form_build_id) in the site search form, so the whole-page digest can differ between sessions while the section body is byte-stable; the reproducible semantic pin is content_digest_sha256 over verbatim_excerpt (the stdlib extractor reproduces the committed zr-35-31 capture's verbatim_excerpt byte-for-byte).

Nothing in this record is a Verified zoning determination (ADR-007: a rule citing it ships under the standing not-professionally-reviewed label with a direct source link; professional review is advisory).
